rules: projectors consume only typed public Session facts, never raw transport frames
canonical nodes are immutable and carry stable nodeId and publicationRevision
assistant chunks stream into one stable assistant node per turn/step
tool call/result pairing uses the public callId and never re-parses raw history
unknown event types become explicit conversation.unknown nodes
known non-surface events are acknowledged without fabricating transcript nodes
renderer never receives this module; terminal-ui consumes presentation nodes through component registry
control metadata, endpoint, sequence and health never enter node values
